electrostriction_ergodic.mechanism: ergodic relaxor: strain is mainly electrostrictive and reversible, domain switching suppressed
electrostriction_ergodic.relation: S = Q P^2; small Pr and negative strain in ergodic relaxors
electrostriction_ergodic.source: Jo et al., J. Appl. Phys. 105 (2009) 094102; Uchino, Ferroelectric Devices

domain_switching_nonergodic.mechanism: irreversible domain switching / field-induced relaxor-to-ferroelectric transition produces the strain
domain_switching_nonergodic.relation: switching strain scales with Pr and the negative strain S_neg
domain_switching_nonergodic.source: Jo et al., J. Appl. Phys. 105 (2009) 094102

zr_lattice_softening.mechanism: Zr4+ (larger, heavier) weakens the B-O bond
zr_lattice_softening.relation: harmonic oscillator nu = (1/2 pi c) sqrt(k/mu): lower k -> lower wavenumber
zr_lattice_softening.source: Nakamoto, Infrared and Raman Spectra of Inorganic Compounds

b_site_stiffening.mechanism: stronger Zr-O bonds stiffen the BO6 octahedra
b_site_stiffening.relation: harmonic oscillator: higher k -> higher wavenumber

zr_lattice_expansion.mechanism: larger Zr4+ (0.72 A) replaces Ti4+ (0.605 A) and expands the lattice
